item.title: Star-studded UL retain Fitzgibbon Cup with impressive Croker display against Mary I
item.description: University of Limerick capped off a remarkable week by defeating Mary Immaculate College on a 4-31 to 3-21 scoreline at Croke Park last night to retain the Fitzgibbon Cup.

item.title: Four players black-carded at the start of fiery Meath-Louth Croker clash
item.description: A row erupted before the throw-in in this afternoon's Allianz Football League clash between Meath and Louth at Croke Park which resulted in four players being black carded.

item.title: Camogie League round-up: Kilkenny, Waterford and Tipp record opening wins
item.description: On a day when meaningful senior inter-county action resumed for the first time since Galway pipped Cork in last year's thrilling All-Ireland senior final, the two counties both succumbed to defeat in the first round of the Centra National Camogie League, with Tipperary taking top spot in Division 1A on the back of their commanding performance against Antrim in Cushendun.

item.title: Wicklow battle past Waterford in second-half towards second win in Division 4
item.description: Wicklow got their second win of this year's Allianz Football League Division 4 campaign by seeing off Waterford on a 0-14 to 0-9 scoreline in Dungarvan this evening.

item.title: Down deal Westmeath first defeat in Division 3 while Laois see off Sligo
item.description: Down inflicted Westmeath with their first loss of the Allianz Football League campaign (2-15 to 1-15) this evening in Newry to move to the top of the Division 3 table.

item.title: Early second-half goals help Derry come out on top against Kildare in Newbridge
item.description: Derry struck three well-timed goals on the way to a 3-15 to 1-18 victory over 14-man Kildare at Cedral St Conleth's Park this evening.

item.title: Flynn the hero again as Royals thwart Louth's comeback at Croker
item.description: Jack Flynn provided more late heroics for Meath this evening as they thwarted Louth's second-half comeback at Croke Park to win by 1-20 to 0-22.

item.title: Galway produce superb comeback to snatch a point from Tralee
item.description: Shane McGrath's late two-pointer saw Galway complete an 11-point turnaround against Kerry in Tralee this evening to earn a draw in this thrilling Allianz Football League Division 1 encounter.

item.title: O'Callaghan two-pointers key as Dubs earn first league win at Monaghan's expense
item.description: Con O'Callaghan came up huge down the home stretch as Dublin claimed their first win of the 2026 Allianz Football League by handing Monaghan their third defeat of the campaign.
